test_title: PYST 52: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: MGRC is related to HCOA in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, VOWB is related to QKTZ. To which of the given options is QNVT related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/735f7c41120157b585d796441090d64665fedbea8f027e2c3d100c49d5614df5.png] 

**Given:**

MGRC → HCOA

VOWB → QKTZ

**Observe the pattern:**

**For, **MGRC → HCOA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3134e6ac7390220992905bbdd0e4707c1bbad2a40e2d02722d778928e00c591f.png] 

The same pattern is followed in:

For, VOWB → QKTZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51dac1adfaf1d215ac47d2e4e3a6e175eab047d9a22d75660f7ea20d5d5118aa.png] 

So, apply the same logic to **QNVT**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fab6527f4846e898bd0035dfca6285baa5d577942146ba9d9bc3f01472cb0bb7.png] 

Therefore,

**QNVT → LJSR**

**Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".**
